name: Nerawareta Tenshi
source:
Though she was just an average girl, everything changed after meeting the demon called Aghee...... 

"You're an angel the likes of which is born only once in several thousand years" 

According to Aghee, there are only male angels and demons and female angels are fated for a life of nothing but giving birth to angels. 

"I'll protect you from the other angels."

Aghee said, as he gently wrapped me up.

But can I really trust a demon?
What the heck is going to happen to me?
I can't just remain a human?

Without finding the answers to her questions, she is thrown into a forbidden romance with a demonic partner.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE222681.html]DLsite English[/url]]
